tools.name: scopeproof.check_action
tools.description: Paid $0.01 deterministic comparison of one proposed action against one supplied authority envelope. Returns within_scope, outside_scope, or review_required plus an Ed25519-signed receipt. ScopeProof does not authenticate the authority issuer, grant platform permission, replace Muse or another host a
